## New in 1.9.7
**Kind of update:** Feature, Bug fix
- **[Feature]** **Everything in one release:** Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iPhone and the plugins are now all here. Android updates itself from these releases from now on.
- **[Feature]** **Sync you can see:** a notice "Connected to ÔÇª" appears when your devices reach each other, and "Device paired" right after scanning the QR code.
- **[Feature]** **Sync reminder:** after 3 days without a sync the app reminds you to open it on the other device. Nothing gets lost meanwhile: marks made apart on both devices all arrive on both.

**Beta.** Update through SideStore (source: `https://trofline.github.io/BibleStudy/sidestore.json`). The IPA is attached when its build is done.

- **[Bug fix]** The side panel steps aside while the settings are open and comes back with the text.
- **[Bug fix]** iPhone: scanning the pairing QR code with the camera pairs the app again.
- **[Bug fix]** The pairing code can be copied: "Copy code" copies the pairing link, with the address of this device, for the field on the other device.

**Beta.** Update through SideStore (source: `https://trofline.github.io/BibleStudy/sidestore.json`). The IPA is attached when its build is done.

Fixes
- The options in the side panel (search scope, word match, more options) no longer lie on top of each other.

**Beta.** Install or update through SideStore (source: https://trofline.github.io/BibleStudy/sidestore.json). The IPA is attached when its build is done.


New
- Select words with your finger: hold on a word, then slide on to select more; lift to pick a color. Lift at once for the verse menu.
- Sync knows which side is newer: a change made on one device replaces the old text on the other instead of being added to it, and deletions travel too (into the trash). A new or empty device never deletes anything on the other.

**Beta, iPhone (SideStore).** Install with SideStore, no paid Apple account needed. Step by step: https://github.com/Trofline/BibleStudy#on-the-phone

Add this source in SideStore: `https://trofline.github.io/BibleStudy/sidestore.json`

First iPhone version: please report what does not work. Same features as the Android beta, including syncing with your PC.
